fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA).

fields.name: BRANCH ID
fields.description: Branch id of the reporting branch

fields.name: REPORTING DATE
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency. Format {DD- MMM-YYYY}

fields.name: CUSTOMER ID
fields.description: Customer unique id linked to the account.

fields.name: CUSTOMER NAME
fields.description: Customer's First Name, Middle Name and Sir Name or registered company Name or Business/Trading Name.

fields.name: ID NUMBER
fields.description: Unique number issued to Kenyans that are 18 years and above.

fields.name: FX CUSTOMER TYPE
fields.description: e.g. Individual, Public financial corporations, Banking Institutions, etc

fields.name: BUSINESS DATE
fields.description: The date of the transaction. Format {YYYYMMDD} as per ISO 8601.

fields.name: TXN REF NUMBER
fields.description: Unique number reference for the transaction

fields.name: TRANSACTION TYPE
fields.description: Whether the transaction is a 'Receipt' or 'Payment'

fields.name: TXN CURRENCY CODE
fields.description: ISO currency codes as per ISO-4217. {e.g. USD, GPB, EUR, KES. etc.}

fields.name: AMOUNT IN TXN CURRENCY
fields.description: Amount in transaction currency

fields.name: AMNT IN LOCAL CUR EQV
fields.description: Corresponding local currency equivalent

fields.name: FX TXN CATEGORY TYPE
fields.description: e.g. SPOT, FORWARD, etc

fields.name: LOCAL CUR FX RATE TYPE
fields.description: SPOT or FORWARD

fields.name: USD CROSS RATE
fields.description: Cross rate of currencies against USD. The USD mean rate for the reporting date as provided by CBK to the reporting institutions.

fields.name: TXN CHARGE_COST IN KES
fields.description: Total charge/cost levied on the transaction

fields.name: FX TXN CHANNEL TYPE
fields.description: The channel used for the receipt/payment of foreign currency

fields.name: ECONOMIC ACTIVITY CODE_ISIC
fields.description: Section, division, group and class as per ISIC guidelines

fields.name: SENDERS DESCRIPTION
fields.description: Description of the sender for 'Receipts' otherwise left blank for 'Payments'

fields.name: FXSM DOMAIN ATTRIBUTE
fields.description: Proceeds from exports of (economic activity description (As per ISIC guidelines), travel services, transportation services, insurance services, communication services, royalties and license fees, investment incomes, embassies, grants, non- official aid, direct investments, portfolio investments, loans received, Kenyan forex bureaus, in transit customer receipts between Kenyan banks and other capital receipts.

fields.name: NATIONALITY
fields.description: ISO country code of the party's Nationality. {As per ISO-3166-1}

fields.name: SENDERS RESIDENCY
fields.description: Resident (Kenya) or Non- resident (Rest of the world). ISO country code of the party's Nationality. {As per ISO-3166-1}.

fields.name: RECEIVERS RESIDENCY
fields.description: Resident (Kenya) or Non- resident (Rest of the world). ISO country code of the party's Nationality. {As per ISO-3166-1}.

fields.name: COUNTRY OF ORIGIN
fields.description: ISO country code of the country of origin. {As per ISO-3166-1}

fields.name: COUNTRY OF DESTINATION
fields.description: ISO country code of the country of destination. {As per ISO-3166-1}
